headline: Chips and Financials Drag as Stocks Lean Lower at Midday
body_html:
Stocks are tilting lower at midday Thursday. Of the 668 names we track, 385 are in the red and 278 are higher, a lopsided split that matches the tone of the tape. Prices are intraday and not final.

Only two groups are positive. Homebuilders are up 0.39% and industrials 0.25%. Materials are nearly flat at -0.06%, while energy is off 0.35%, consumer names 0.5%, healthcare 0.63% and software 0.76%. The real damage is in financials, down 1.46%, and semiconductors, down 1.49%. Those two groups are setting the direction of the session.

Single-stock moves are wide. DPC Holdings leads the board, up 8.11%, with Tetra Tech up 5.69% and EnerSys up 5.02%. On the downside, Digi International is down 18.88% and Corteva 18.74%. Into the close, watch whether chip weakness spreads further, whether financials find a floor, and whether the latest Strait of Hormuz headlines start to move crude.

briefs.headline: Industrial names carry the leadership group
briefs.body: Industrials are one of only two sectors in positive territory, up 0.25%. The gains are driven by a few strong individual movers: DPC Holdings is up 8.11%, Tetra Tech 5.69% and EnerSys 5.02%. That keeps the group modestly higher despite the weak market.

briefs.headline: Financials and chips share the bottom spot
briefs.body: Semiconductors are down 1.49% and financials 1.46%, the two weakest groups at midday. With 385 stocks lower against 278 higher, the selling is clearly broad. Whether either group steadies will shape how the session ends.

briefs.headline: Tokyo Electron bucks the chip slump
briefs.body: Tokyo Electron is up 5.63%, making it one of the best performers on the board even as the broader semiconductor group slides 1.49%. The split suggests the chip selloff is not uniform. Equipment makers are being treated differently from the rest of the group.

briefs.headline: Digi International and Corteva fall hardest
briefs.body: Digi International is down 18.88% and Corteva is down 18.74%, the steepest drops in our universe at midday. Forgent Power Solutions is also lower, off 9.96%. Such large moves usually reflect company-specific news, so these names are worth watching into the afternoon.

briefs.headline: Life-science tools stocks under pressure
briefs.body: Azenta is down 8.17% and 10x Genomics is down 7.52%, while Legend Biotech has slipped 6.78%. Healthcare as a whole is off 0.63%, with the losses concentrated in the research-tools corner of the sector.

briefs.headline: Hormuz tanker incident keeps oil in focus
briefs.body: Reports say two tankers were disabled by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, adding to the regional tension. Crude is edging lower anyway as rising output offsets the geopolitical risk. Energy stocks are down 0.35% at midday.
